svg.title: Approval Reviewer: a second model approves low-risk calls
svg.desc: ApprovalReviewer runs in the handle_deferred_tool_calls hook, on tool calls that need approval. A second model is asked one risk question about the call run_shell(command="find . -name '*.py' | wc -l"). A no approves the call and it runs in the same run step; a yes, unsure or a failed review leaves the call for a person, as it would be without the reviewer.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
